name: Second Secret
source:
Businessmen and Detective themed "reading love" BL novel adventure.

If two secrets are overcome, this love will flourish....

At a small investigations firm tucked away in a corner of Shibuya, Chitose Chika, is shown three photographs.

Each picture showed a different smartly dressed, professional-looking businessman.

"I want you to take on one of these cases."

After the boss said that, Chika picked his target.

It SHOULD have just been work....
